system.description:
Opportunity 1, Escalation 2

These personal shields were sometimes issued to security and combat personnel, though the power requirements of such devices mean they have limited use in protracted fighting. A character with a personal force field gains the listed Resistance, but must roll 1 Challende Die after each time they are hit by an attack; if an Effect is rolled, the force field loses power for the rest of the scene, and no longer provides Resistance.
